children: Tony Xu Han, Chairman and CEO and a director, purchased 597,918 Class A ordinary shares on November 24, 2026, at $0.9933 per share, for a total purchase amount of $593,912. The shares represent 199,306 American depositary shares purchased in the open market, with each ADS representing three Class A ordinary shares. Han directly owned 1,091,352 Class A ordinary shares following the transaction, including 493,434 restricted share units previously reported.
